subject: Gerudo's Training Ground
text: The Gerudo's Training Ground is located in the southeast corner of the Fortress behind a door blocked by a metal grating.

evidence.quote: From this point on, you can complete the Gerudo's Training Ground at any time.  It's in the southeast corner of the Fortress.  Speak with the guard out front of the door blocked by a metal grating, pay the entrance fee and she'll let you inside.

subject: Gerudo's Training Ground
text: The Ice Arrows can be obtained in the Training Ground, though finishing every room requires the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: You can complete the Training Ground and get the Ice Arrows now, but you won't be able to finish every room in the Training Ground without the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: Riding up the eastern passage on Epona leads to the Horseback Archery Range.

evidence.quote: On Epona, ride up the passage that leads east to reach the massive Horseback Archery Range.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula hangs high on the target on the north side of the Horseback Archery Range and can be killed with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: If you're after the Gold Skulltula here, then it's high on the target on the north side of the area.  Use the Longshot to kill it and take it's token, then return to the awning near the south side of the gallery.

subject: Gerudo in White
text: A Gerudo dressed in white stands beneath the awning on the south side of the gallery during the daytime to host the horseback archery game.

evidence.quote: Speak with the Gerudo dressed in white beneath the awning (she only appears during the daytime, so use the Sun's Song if you need to), and pay her the fee to play the game.  You must be riding Epona before you speak to her (unless you don't have Epona, in which case you just speak to her on foot).

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: If you do not have Epona, the Gerudos will lend you one of their horses for the shooting range.

evidence.quote: If you don't have Epona, then don't fret; the Gerudo's will sportingly let you borrow one of their horses for the Shooting Range.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Scoring at least 1,000 points with twenty arrows in the Horseback Archery Range awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: You get twenty arrows to use, and in order to win the Piece of Heart from this game you must score at least 1,000 points....Once you score 1,000 points, you'll win the Piece of Heart.

subject: Arrow Quiver x50
text: Scoring at least 1,500 points in the Horseback Archery Range awards the Biggest Quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: Play the game again and score at least 1,500 to earn the Quiver.  If you score 1,500 or more on your first attempt, then you have to play again to earn the Quiver and repeat the feat.

subject: Haunted Wasteland Gate
text: Speaking to the Gerudo atop the northwest tower opens the gate leading into the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Biggest Quiver, the Piece of Heart, and the Ice Arrows (if you choose), then head for the northwest corner of the Fortress and climb to the top of the tower there.  Speak with the Gerudo at the top, and she'll open the gate for you.  Run through the gate and into the desert to enter the Haunted Wasteland.

subject: Haunted Wasteland Entrance
text: Crossing the sinking sand gap at the entrance requires using the Longshot on the crate situated across the gap.

evidence.quote: To begin with, you will appear between a pair of flags.  Run forward through the flags, and past the crate until you reach a large gap filled with sinking sand.  Use the Longshot on the crate on the other side of the gap to pull yourself over.

subject: Flag Trail
text: Straying too far from the trail of flags warps Link back to the beginning of the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: Start running to the next flag you can see to the northwest, and continue in a similar fashion from flag to flag.  If you stray too far from a flag, then you will be warped back to the start of the Wasteland.

subject: Song of Storms
text: Playing the Song of Storms causes lightning to briefly illuminate the horizon, revealing the position of the next flag.

evidence.quote: If you can't see where the next flag is, then you can play the Song of Storms.  The lightning caused by the storm will briefly light up the horizon, revealing the next flag.

subject: Carpet Merchant
text: Following the sign after the second flag leads to the Carpet Merchant, who sells Bombchus.

evidence.quote: After the second flag in the series, you will reach a sign which points you to the Carpet Merchant.  Follow the sign to the Merchant if you like, but all he sells is Bombchus.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula is located at the bottom of the pit inside the stone structure surrounded by red flags.

evidence.quote: At the end of the path of flags, you will reach a large stone structure surrounded by a circle of red flags.  Near the south side of the structure is an opening.  Go through it, and drop down the cliff to it's bottom.  Kill the Gold Skulltula at the bottom of the pit, and take it's token with the Longshot.

subject: Purple Rupee Chest
text: Lighting both torches inside the pit with Din's Fire or Fire Arrows makes a chest containing a Purple Rupee appear.

evidence.quote: If you light both of the torches with Din's Fire or Fire Arrows, then a chest containing a Purple Rupee will appear.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: Activating the Lens of Truth atop the stone structure reveals a guiding ghost that leads the way across the desert to the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote: Standing on top of the structure and facing north, turn on the Lens of Truth to see a ghost....Follow the ghost on it's winding path through the desert, and you will eventually see a pair of flags....From the pair of double flags, you'll see another flag to the west.  Run towards it to enter the Desert Colossus.

subject: Leevers
text: Leevers only surface in the sand, so moving onto solid ground protects Link from their attacks.

evidence.quote: The Leevers are weak and can only appear in the sand, so if you run quickly to any part of the ground that isn't sand then you're safe from them.

subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
text: Bombing the cracked wall between the two trees to the right of the Wasteland entrance reveals the Great Fairy's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Head for the pair of trees to your right as you enter from the Haunted Wasteland.  There is a crack in the wall between the two trees.  Use a bomb to blow it open, then enter the doorway you created.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol inside the Great Fairy's Fountain grants the magic spell Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: Run into the fountain and stand on the Triforce symbol.  Play Zelda's Lullaby, and the Great Fairy of Sexual Dominance will appear to give you Nayru's Love, the final magic spell in the game.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Nayru's Love renders Link invulnerable to damage, consuming one-quarter of a full magic meter per cast.

evidence.quote: By far the most useful of the three, Nayru's Love makes you invulnerable to all damage....The only downside to Nayru's Love is it uses one-quarter of your magic bar to cast (half of it if you haven't gotten the Magic Bar Upgrade).

subject: Oasis Fairy Fountain
text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the flat rocks near the dried oasis refills it with water to create a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Head for the dried up oasis in the south of the area.  If you stand on the pile of flat rocks near the oasis and play the Song of Storms, then the oasis will be refilled with water and becomes a Fairy Fountain.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula is perched near the fronds of a palm tree near the oasis and can be gathered using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: On one of the palm trees near the Oasis is a Gold Skulltula.  It's near the top, near the fronds.  Kill it and take it's token with the Longshot.

subject: Spirit Temple Entrance
text: The entrance to the Spirit Temple is located at the base of the massive Colossus statue in the west of the area.

evidence.quote: Now head for the Colossus itself, the huge stone statue in the west corner of the area.  Enter the small door at it's base.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: Exiting the Spirit Temple triggers an encounter with Sheik, who teaches the Requiem of Spirit to warp to the desert as a child.

evidence.quote: Sheik will appear in front of you, and make some cryptic remark about using the Master Sword as a boat to sail on the rivers of time, and using the song to reach the Desert as a Child.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Dropping a bottled bug into the soft soil patch to the left of the Spirit Temple entrance unearths a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head for the entrance to the Spirit Temple.  To the left of the door there is the game's final patch of soft earth.  Drop a Bottled Bug in the patch to make a Skulltula appear, and don't bother recapturing one of the bugs - you won't need them anymore.  Kill the Skulltula and take it's token.

subject: Bugs
text: Bugs can be captured under a rock located north of the oasis.

evidence.quote: If you need a new Bug, then they can be found underneath a rock north of the Oasis.

subject: Magic Bean
text: Link can plant his final Magic Bean into the soft soil patch to the left of the Spirit Temple entrance.

evidence.quote: Plant your final Magic Bean in the patch of soft earth, then head into the temple.
